title: Live: B1G Tailgate
description: Start off game day with the Big Ten Network crew previewing this week's games from around the conference. Plus, Camryn Irwin and Tyvis Powell travel to campus for interviews and on-site analysis. B1G Tailgate is the home for Big Ten football fans on Saturdays with original features, special guests and college football analysis.

title: Live: B1G Countdown to Kickoff
description: Countdown to Kickoff takes you on the field leading up to game time with previews of the day's biggest games, plus the latest news from reporters across the country.

title: Live: College Football
description: The Terrapins (2-6, 0-5 Big Ten) try to snap a six-game slide as they visit the Boilermakers (3-5, 2-3). Purdue has dropped two straight after prevailing in the previous two. Boilermakers sophomore running back Fame Ijeboi boasts 10 touchdowns.

title: B1G Live: Football Game Break
description: Our analysts check in on the action all across the B1G as football Saturday continues.

title: Live: College Football
description: The Badgers (5-3, 3-2 Big Ten) try to continue their mastery of the Scarlet Knights (2-6, 1-4). The Badgers have won all six get-togethers, by an average of 30 points. Wisconsin tries to get its offense back in gear following a 30-0 loss to Iowa.
